sources.license_summary: Official public government announcement published for the call for proposals; no explicit license, free to cite for informational purposes.

sources.notes: Agent-facing open-call principles, six required agent tasks, three positionings, five functions, three-areas-two-wings, scenario/branding/operation requirements, and the uniform boundary clause. Referenced in proposal.md as [source:AGENT-TASKBOOK] (legacy scaffold id).

sources.title: 城市设计管理办法
sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国住房和城乡建设部
sources.license_summary: Official Chinese government normative document; public government publication, free to cite.
sources.notes: National urban design management measures grounding the urban design purpose and scope, public space and city character requirements, and building height, volume, style, and color control references. Local reference copy: brief/site-package/standards/references/mohurd-urban-design-measures.md.

sources.license_summary: Official Chinese government normative document; public government publication, free to cite.
sources.notes: National land use and sea use classification guide used for land use codes and classification terminology in the land use structure analysis. Local reference copy: brief/site-package/standards/references/mnr-land-use-classification-guide.md.

sources.title: 百年京张AI创新带临时粗略边界与三处重点区 polygon
sources.license_summary: Repository-maintained provisional geometry for this competition; not an official document; derived from the official pre-announcement text descriptions.
sources.notes: Provisional rough boundary and three key area polygons used for AI generation, visualization, and intake self-check only. NOT an official redline: all spatial metrics must be recalculated once the official boundary is released. Referenced in matrices as BOUNDARY-SOURCE and KEY-AREA-SOURCE (legacy scaffold ids).

sources.title: Breakthrough Listen Open Data Archive — SETI and radio astronomy public data
sources.publisher: UC Berkeley SETI Research Center (Breakthrough Listen)
sources.license_summary: Publicly released open data archive (1+ PB of radio telescope observations); public download permitted with attribution; specialized analysis tools (blimpy, turboSETI) required.
sources.notes: Background public-data basis for the interstellar communication concept: SETI data nodes, public radio observatory terrace, and interstellar information sculpture park at StarBridge Dialogue Port (星桥·对话港). Used as cultural/spatial concept reference only; the proposal claims no confirmed interstellar communication.
